links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers to patient tooth whitening questions (FRE, SMOG)
links.effect: Mean FRE score of 36.3 ("difficult" level) and SMOG index of 11.0, requiring a high school reading level.
links.quote: However, readability was a major limitation, with a mean FRE score of 36.3 ("difficult" level) and a SMOG index of 11.0, requiring a high school reading level.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM responses versus average patient health literacy
links.effect: Mean FRE 36.3 (difficult) and SMOG 11.0; responses delivered at a reading level incompatible with average patient health literacy.
links.quote: Contemporary LLMs provide useful and reliable information on tooth whitening but deliver it at a reading level incompatible with average patient health literacy.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance, reliability, and readability of multiple LLMs answering patient questions about tooth whitening without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
